Mr. Jayabhar Dattatraya R., Advocate for Applicant
,Mr. N. R. Dayma, Agp for Respondent State

Mr. Gulab B. Rajale, Advocate for Respondent No.2
 Coram : Y. G. Khobragade, J.
 Date : 29th September, 2025
1. The applicants/original claimants have filed the present application seeking permission to withdraw 50% amount of compensation with interest accrued thereon.

2. Mr. Gulab B. Rajale, learned counsel appearing for the Non- applicant No.2-Acquiring Body submits that the issue involved in the present appeal is in respect of grant of interest under Section 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, either from the date of possession or from the date of award.

This issue is no longer res integra in view of the judgment and order dated 16.08.2024 passed by this Court in First Appeal No.1543 of 2023 (MKVDC Versus Bhagwant Gangaram Kolekar) and other connected matters.
